description: The chart is a pie chart that represents the hierarchical taxonomy and data distribution of task categories in the MMAR benchmark. There are a total of 10 slices, each representing a different task category. The largest slice, accounting for 40.4% of the chart, is labeled "Perception Layer." The second largest slice, representing 41.2%, is labeled "Semantic Layer." The remaining slices are smaller, with the third largest being "Content Analysis" at 14.1%, followed by "Emotion & Intention Analysis" at 4.3%, and "Speaker Analysis" at 2%. The other slices are labeled "Spatial Analysis," "Temporal Analysis," "Correlation Analysis," "Music Theory," "Counting & Statistics," "Environmental Perception & Reasoning," "Audio Difference Analysis," "Anomaly Detection," and "Signal Layer." The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any slices that are visually emphasized. The slices are ordered in a way that the largest category is at the center, with the other categories radiating outward.
